inlines.v: FROUNCE, noun A distemper of hawks, in which white spittle gathers about the bill. [See the Verb.] FROUNCE, verb transitive To curl or frizzle the hair about the face. Not tricked and frounced as she was wont. FROUNCE, noun A wrinkle, plait or curl; an ornament of dress.
